newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs jump as unexpected rise causes short-squeeze.
newsitem.headline: JGBs jump as unexpected rise causes short-squeeze.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGB futures contract closed higher on Thursday mainly due to dealers' short-squeezing.
*Many operators did not expect such steep rise and this resulted in contract's hitting new life high of 125.40.
*Fall in stocks, including bank shares, supportive.
